vectors.title: Cross-Line Compensating Price Drift Preserving TDS Total
vectors.attack_mechanism: IT1 line 1 price is inflated (+$4.00 x 10 = +$40.00) while IT1 line 2 price is discounted (-$10.00 x 4 = -$40.00) so TDS*120000 still equals PO AMT*TT*1200.00 ($1,200.00). Tests whether evaluator only checks document totals.
